korean:
세상은 어둡고 너무 고요한데
네 마음은 그렇지 못해
넌 잠들지 못하지 쉽게
romanization:
sesangeun eodupgo neomu goyohande
ne maeumeun geureochi mothae
neon jamdeulji mothaji shipge
english:
The world is dark and so quiet
But your heart isn't
You can't easily fall asleep

korean:
차가운 밤공기 창을 열어둔 채
턱을 괴며 말해
romanization:
chagaun bamgongi changeul yeoreodun chae
teogeul gwemyeo malhae
english:
With the cold night air leaving the window open
Resting your chin on your hand, you say
I want to see you once more

korean:
참 이상하지, 네 한마디면
난 초능력이 생겨
까맣던 세상이 무지개 색깔로
하늘을 채우던 날
romanization:
cham isanghaji, ne hanmadimyeon
nan choneungryeogi saenggyeo
kkamateon sesangi mujigae saekkkallo
haneureul chaeundeon nal
english:
Isn't it strange
With just one word from you, I gain superpowers
On the day the pitch-black world 
filled the sky with rainbow colors

korean:
아이같이 뛰며 웃던 너
I keep on holding
내 맘을 다 몰라줘도 난
Forever and ever and ever
romanization:
aigachi ttwimyeo utteon neo
I keep on holding
nae mameul da mollajweodo nan
Forever and ever and ever
english:
You, laughing and jumping like a child
I keep on holding
Even if you don't know all of my heart
Forever and ever and ever

korean:
절대 시들지 않을
넌 나의 꽃잎 fireworks
romanization:
jeoldae shideulji aneul
neon naye kkochip fireworks
english:
You'll never wither
You are my petal, fireworks

Oh, you and I were shining in the dark
Forever and ever and ever

korean:
펑 하고 터질 때 봤지
너는 하늘, 나는 너를
아직도 잊을 수 없지
처음 손을 잡던 날은
romanization:
pyeong hago teojil ttae bwatji
neoneun haneul, naneun neoreul
ajikdo ijeul su eopji
cheoeum soneul japteon nareun
english:
I saw it when it burst with a bang
You are the sky, I am you
I still can't forget
The day we first held hands

english:

That thing called eternal love
The moment I saw you, I completely believed it
